notes.title: Update V1.030 and future development
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ﻿Fixed many maps. (Will continue polishing and balancing until they are final)
[*] ﻿Slight adjustments towards player movement, gun handling, sight alignment, and enemy accuracy.
[*] ﻿Fixed some dating scene bugs.
[*] ﻿Bug Fix: Switching between weapons will refill ammo.
[*] ﻿Added one special scenario for Maria.﻿﻿
[*] ﻿Added a button to save the game manually (on the top left)
[*] ﻿Bug Fix: DLCs get automatically uninstalled after returning to the main menu.
[*] ﻿﻿Reduced anti-aliasing a little to reduce blur at a far distance and hopefully reduce a bit of motion-sickness.
[/list]

﻿So regarding the current update plans/roadmap, here are a few key points.

-Polish current missions.

﻿-Polish combat balance.

﻿-Better dialog localization.

﻿-Mini-game. (Another option to increase affection)

﻿-A more integrated dating experience (still planning)

﻿-Collectible outfits for each girl and the wardrobe try-on feature.﻿

﻿-Achievements and steam achievements.

﻿-Survival mode.

﻿-We also planned to have regular mission updates (on a two weeks basis) as well as new dating plots for each girl. However, ﻿﻿that will be possible only after the current game content is more polished. And when that happens we will mark any upcoming content inside of the game so you know when and what to expect (Kinda like an in-game roadmap, upcoming content will be locked and an approx unlocking date will be displayed).

notes.title: The only thing hotter than weapons of war is your Army.
notes.content:
Hi there! 
We are excited to introduce to you Wars and Roses! 

[b]This is a story of love and war.[/b]

[h3]Wondering if this game is your type? [/h3]

Do you like military girls? Do you like tactical shooters? Do you like dating sims? Then this game is for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/3077308fe557beb9c0aa6d4f4bdc802ec014c0a1.jpg[/img]

[h3]What makes this game unique? [/h3]

Wars and Roses is a one-of-a-kind intense tactical FPS where you fight battles alongside female officers and interact with those beauties in a 3D dating sim. Rescue captured officers, gain affection by dating in various scenarios to unlock unique interactions and fight side-by-side on an anti-terrorism campaign.

Win the war and conquer your officers' hearts.

[h3]What is the gameplay?[/h3]
[list]
[*] An intense close-quarter tactical shooter that features sneaky AI and bullet physics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/745e5884dfc4546f7da99b7a56165e0793cfe440.jpg[/img]

[*] Beautiful female companions who fight alongside you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/fd6c98ff07eabe335151c370aef65d317e2407f6.jpg[/img]

[*] Date with each female companion and unlock their unique scenarios, dialog, and interactions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/0282fa764fe986148d376b5b961a44a1d7738d1e.jpg[/img]

[*] Fight a global campaign against the terrorists on various maps and missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/30b1ea4e96a00768ce1f31b27c18697c62a71efb.jpg[/img]

[*] Earn money to improve your weapons, skills and buy gifts to impress your companions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/260a321d5f80c2237b786cf15db3c03fc15de085.jpg[/img]

[*] Recruit more stunning beauties by rescuing them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356869/6be71684c4d0ee6fb4f90dd074f2215463690cb3.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3]What's the lore of the game? [/h3]
Set in a modern-day military world, the all-female private military company "Black Rose" is established to battle a terrorist group hiding worldwide. The player is asked to join and lead the squad after the majority of its members were captured in a recent battle...

[h3]What do developers want to make?[/h3]
Our mission is to redefine the FPS genre by combining two types of games into one. To reward the players with an unprecedented level of sophistication, depth, and fun.



[h3]Got any more questions? Write them down below and we will cover it up![/h3]
